records.retained_takeaway: Link-MoE uses pair-specific softmax expert weights from separate MLP branches over structural heuristics and endpoint Hadamard features, then sigmoid of the weighted expert-score sum. Experts train independently and their inferred scores train a second-stage gate. Uniform/global ensembles and LP stacking are explicit controls.
